text: Onions and garlic are indispensable ingredients that impart a lot of flavor and aroma to dishes. They are often sautéed or fried to add a savory taste to stir-fries, omelets, and casseroles. Using them in moderation prevents them from overpowering other flavors. To properly prepare onions and garlic, wash them well and remove tough outer layers. Then, chop them into small pieces and sauté them in a pan with a small amount of oil until they become translucent. This can take anywhere from a few minutes to an hour, depending on the thickness of the onions and your preference. Once they're done, you can add them to your dish as desired, or use them to make a classic Greek salad or a delicious garlic roasted potato side dish. With a little practice, you can master the art of cooking with onions and garlic and create a wide variety of delicious meals to enjoy!
